# Search matching

Search matches case-insensitive substrings of ASCII item names and preserves input order. Supported item names contain ASCII characters only. Empty queries return all rows; absent matches and empty input return no rows. Inputs are validated before search.

# Name search

## Accepted behavior

search_items(items, query) performs Unicode case-insensitive substring matching in input order. STRASSE matches Straße. Empty queries return all items; absent matches and empty input return []. Inputs are validated. Existing shelf-message and stock-total behavior stays unchanged.

The accepted design is in docs/planning/search/design.md. Implementation issue: https://github.com/example/inventory/issues/11.

## Continuation

Planning PR https://github.com/example/inventory/pull/12 merged the earlier ASCII-only search design. The later accepted Unicode revision is an uncommitted change to docs/planning/search/design.md in the current checkout and has not been published or merged. Required planning document delivery for that revision is unfinished.
